name: Can a tub-to-shower conversion be done in a one-day bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can a real tub-to-shower conversion be completed in one day, or is that usually a sales claim?
mainEntity.text: Can a real tub-to-shower conversion be completed in one day, or is that usually a sales claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: A one-day tub-to-shower conversion is real in some cases, but it usually applies to a very specific type of project. Prefabricated shower systems installed over a predictable existing layout can move quickly when the plumbing is straightforward and the walls are in good shape. However, once the job includes tile, custom glass, drain relocation, waterproofing repairs, or hidden damage, one day is rarely enough. Homeowners should treat a one-day promise as a question to verify, not a universal rule. Ask exactly what is being installed, what materials are used, and whether the timeline includes final trim, caulking, or follow-up visits. A fast install can be useful, especially if the bathroom is the only one in the home, but speed should never replace proper preparation and waterproofing. The right project timeline depends on complexity, not marketing language.
acceptedAnswer.description: A one-day conversion is possible only for certain prefabricated systems and very simple conditions. If plumbing changes, custom tile, repair work, or inspections are needed, the project usually takes longer than one day.
